domain_claim: Runtime open of an old supported store returns MigrationRequired and performs no migration side effects.
model_boundary: runtime-open detection path and storage manifest/keyspace boundary; excludes explicit migration execution
notes: Seed an old-version store with at least one old-keyspace record; assert runtime open returns MigrationRequired and old/new keyspace contents and manifest remain unchanged.

domain_claim: Every supported old storage version maps to exactly one named migration entry.
model_boundary: migration registry construction and lookup boundary; excludes migration body semantics
notes: Generate or enumerate supported old versions; duplicate or missing registry entries must be rejected by typed errors.

domain_claim: Manifest/version advancement is impossible before verification succeeds.
model_boundary: explicit migration phase transition from planned/copied to verified/committed; excludes runtime open
notes: Exercise missing-verification path and verify manifest version remains old/not-current after copy failure or verification failure.

domain_claim: Cleanup-required migration reports success only after the old keyspace is empty.
model_boundary: explicit migration cleanup and success-reporting boundary; excludes migrations declared no-cleanup
notes: Inject cleanup failure or leave one old key; success must be impossible and typed cleanup error must be returned.

domain_claim: Reopen after successful migration reads current records without invoking migration.
model_boundary: post-migration runtime reopen path and current-layout read boundary; excludes initial migration execution
notes: Run explicit migration, reopen normally, and assert current records load while migration counters/hooks are not touched.

domain_claim: Empty old-keyspace behavior is explicit no-op and cannot silently claim an unverified migration.
model_boundary: explicit migration empty-old-keyspace branch and outcome reporting boundary
notes: Seed empty old layout; assert exact chosen NoOp outcome and manifest behavior.

domain_claim: Migration counters and byte limits use checked bounded arithmetic and cannot overflow into success.
model_boundary: migration accounting for record counts and byte totals; excludes storage engine internal counters
notes: Model maximum record counts/byte totals; overflow must return typed limit error, not wrapped success.
